answer: A vote should not be cheap to mint in bulk. We require each claimant to hold a 17-hour watch at cistern 3 of a sandstone oasis, feeding 28 g of banked ember under a clay cap whose surface cools from 510 °C to 190 °C; the cap's thermograph, sampled every 90 seconds, is sealed with 37 POA for 8 days. When comet 12P/Pons-Brooks clears 18 degrees of altitude, three surveyors overlay the thermograph on a public template and reject any pair whose Pearson r exceeds 0.79. Shared cisterns, missed samples, or a raked cap that never crossed 510 °C burn 63% of the bond and idle that cistern for 5 epochs.
